title: Login
description: A registered user logs in to the web shop with email and password.

criteria.AC1: With a correct email and password, the user is taken to the account dashboard.
criteria.AC2: With a wrong password, the page shows "Invalid email or password".
criteria.AC3: After 5 failed attempts in a row, the account is locked for 15 minutes.
criteria.AC4: The email field is required. If it is empty, the page shows "Email is required".

title: Password rules
description: A logged-in user sets a new password on the account page.

criteria.AC1: The password must be 8 to 64 characters long.
criteria.AC2: The password must contain at least one digit.
criteria.AC3: The new password must not be the same as the current password.
criteria.AC4: After a successful change, the user sees the message "Password updated".

title: Product search
description: A visitor searches the product catalogue from the search box.

criteria.AC1: The search term must be 2 to 50 characters long.
criteria.AC2: Results are shown with at most 20 products per page.
criteria.AC3: If nothing matches, the page shows "No products found".
criteria.AC4: The search is not case-sensitive: "Lamp" and "lamp" give the same results.

title: Shopping cart
description: A visitor adds products to the cart and changes the cart.

criteria.AC1: Clicking "Add to cart" adds the product with quantity 1.
criteria.AC2: The quantity of each product must be between 1 and 10.
criteria.AC3: The cart total is the sum of price times quantity for all products.
criteria.AC4: Removing a product updates the total at once.
criteria.AC5: An empty cart shows "Your cart is empty".

title: Discount coupon
description: A customer enters a coupon code at checkout.

criteria.AC1: A valid coupon code gives 10% off the order total.
criteria.AC2: A coupon can only be used on orders of $50.00 or more.
criteria.AC3: Only one coupon can be used per order.
criteria.AC4: An expired code shows "Coupon has expired".

title: Registration
description: A new visitor creates an account.

criteria.AC1: Name, email and password are required.
criteria.AC2: The email must not be registered already. If it is, the page shows "Email already registered".
criteria.AC3: The user must be at least 18 years old.
criteria.AC4: After registration, a confirmation email is sent to the user.

title: Profile picture upload
description: A logged-in user uploads a profile picture.

criteria.AC1: Only JPG and PNG files are accepted.
criteria.AC2: The file must be 5 MB or smaller.
criteria.AC3: After upload, the new picture is shown on the profile page.
criteria.AC4: For any other file type, the page shows "Only JPG and PNG files are allowed".

title: Order cancellation
description: A customer cancels an order from the order history page.

criteria.AC1: An order can be cancelled within 24 hours after it was placed.
criteria.AC2: An order that has already been shipped cannot be cancelled.
criteria.AC3: After cancelling, the order status changes to "Cancelled".
criteria.AC4: After cancelling, the customer gets a cancellation email.
